registration.title: Attack and defence goals, a home edge for each club, and line-ups by line
registration.what: Three additions to the match projection: the goal total comes mostly from an attack and defence figure for each club; each club has its own home edge on top of the standard one; and the expected margin moves with the difference between the two predicted line-ups in defence, midfield and attack.
registration.why: The projection knew how strong each side was but not how open its games are, how much it gains at home, or who was likely to start.
registration.how: The base goal total is 75% the attack and defence model's and 25% the twelve-month averages'. The margin moves by the two clubs' home edges, and by 0.005 goals for each point of difference between the predicted line-ups' lines. The goalkeeper line is left out because it made predictions worse.
registration.hypothesis: Each addition improves the result and goal markets on its own, and together they improve every market.
registration.success_criteria: Not specified in what survives: the guide records the test, not a bar set beforehand.
